title: Refunds and Billing Adjustments Policy
content:
Refunds and Billing Adjustments Policy

Document ID: Policy_C20_refund_policy

Category: C20 — Refunds & Adjustments

Department: Billing

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

1. Purpose

Defines eligibility and timelines for refunds arising from duplicate charges, billing errors, or service-credit commitments.

2. Policy Statements

Confirmed duplicate or erroneous charges are refunded in full.

Refunds to source payment methods are processed within 5-7 working days of approval; account-balance credits are processed within 24 hours.

SLA-breach service credits (e.g., broadband downtime) are applied automatically without requiring a customer request.
